sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Customs is a location in Escape from Tarkov. It is the second map that was added to the game.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A large area of industrial park land situated adjacent to the factory zone. The area houses a customs terminal, fuel storage facilities, offices, and dorms, as well as a variety of other infrastructure and buildings.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: Customs is initially only accessible by transiting. Direct access from the location selection screen is unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter Tour.

sections.heading: Features
sections.text:
- Stationary weapons in the form of AGS-30 30x29mm automatic grenade launchers and NSV Utyos 12.7x108 heavy machine guns.
- Be aware of Border Snipers!

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- The location was first slightly expanded with patch 0.6.0.861 on January 19, 2018.
- The location was expanded for the second time with patch 0.11.0.2448 on December 25, 2018.
- The location was expanded again with patch 0.12.7.8334 on July 20, 2020.
- The location was completely reworked and expanded with patch 0.16.0.0.34447 on December 26, 2024.
